occurrences.englishText: For with you is the spring of life.
You crown the year with your bounty.
A loving doe and a graceful deer—
Come, let’s take our fill of loving until the morning.
The liberal soul shall be made fat.

Therefore I will weep with the weeping of Jazer for the vine of Sibmah. I will water you with my tears, Heshbon, and Elealeh: for on your summer fruits and on your harvest the battle shout has fallen.
For my sword has drunk its fill in the sky.
The wild oxen will come down with them,
You have bought me no sweet cane with money,
For as the rain comes down and the snow from the sky,
I will satiate the soul of the priests with fatness,
For I have satiated the weary soul, and I have replenished every sorrowful soul.”
For that day is of the Lord, Yahweh of Armies,
He has filled me with bitterness.
